text:
maya_cs: Heads-up — ZenHealth (UK pilot) emailed asking for a temporary QPS bump and proxy IP allowlist so their onboarding tests don't hit 429s. Renewal review is in ~5 weeks, so want a smooth pilot this week. They saw a burst that triggered rate limits last night during data migration.

sam_ops: Can you paste the IPs and the exact window they want? Also which region should we pin to (they mentioned London).

maya_cs: Sure — asking for 2x QPS for 72 hours starting Tue 09:00 UTC, pin to eu-west-2 (London), and allowlist these outbound proxies: 34.213.12.45, 34.213.12.46, 52.18.94.101. Customer contact is emma@zenhealth.co. 

leo_net: Quick check — are those source IPs for their NAT gateway or for our peering? If peering we need tickets to network.

maya_cs: They said NAT gateway (managed by their infra partner). They asked us to add ephemeral allowlist to avoid proxy blocks.

anita_pdm: Important: record this as a provisioning event tied to their renewal so we can flag success metrics. Can we add a note in Gainsight/CS repo after it's live?

sam_ops: I'll stage a temporary rate window config. Proposed config snippet: ```
{"customer": "zenhealth", "region": "eu-west-2", "qps_delta": "+100%", "start_utc": "2026-03-24T09:00:00Z", "end_utc": "2026-03-27T09:00:00Z", "allowlist": ["34.213.12.45", "34.213.12.46", "52.18.94.101"], "reason": "onboard pilot"}
```

deploybot: @sam_ops scheduled rate-window job created: job_id=job-zen-4312349876-1, trigger=2026-03-24T09:00:00Z.

rob_sre: I'll add the network ACLs and confirm peering not required. tagging @leo_net for visibility. ETA 30m to apply. :thumbsup:

leo_net: Confirmed — peering not needed. I checked remote ASN; NAT IPs look legit, will monitor for spoofing.

maya_cs: Awesome — please update me when the allowlist + rate bump is live so I can tell Emma and schedule the enablement demo. Also adding a renewal note per @anita_pdm.

rob_sre: Done. Applied allowlist + rate-window in staging and promoted to prod. Monitoring metrics for 2 hours. Link to dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/ops/zenhealth-4312349876

maya_cs: Thanks all — I'll post a short enablement checklist to the customer and confirm the demo time after they verify ingress. :rocket:
